acceptance.behavior: The public signup route renders the CAPTCHA security gate.
Desktop and mobile signup show required, complete, expired, error, and unavailable security-check states.
A verified challenge permits Supabase Auth to persist the exact-revision signup account.
CAPTCHA-protected signup preserves the selected role in durable user metadata.
The existing login and Supabase signup flow carries the verified CAPTCHA token without a parallel runtime.
Playwright exercises the real challenge gate, outgoing signup request, persistence, desktop, and mobile behavior.
The labeled security region exposes live verification state and is scanned for serious or critical axe violations.
Email signup fails closed until a challenge token exists and resets the one-time token after a rejected signup.
